title: Design an Algorithmic Stablecoin based on a Predictive PID Controller
abstract: arXiv:2611.30982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cryptocurrencies issued based on blockchain technology have attracted increasing attention in recent years. However, their high volatility makes it difficult for them to become circulating currencies. This led to the creation of stablecoins. Existing stablecoins can be divided into three main categories: stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies, stablecoins collateralized by crypto assets, and algorithmically controlled stablecoins. Most existing stablecoins are either of the first two types. We design an algorithmic stablecoin controlled only by a predictive Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller, which uses the price forecasted by Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model as part of its input. Simulation experiments show that, under ideal market conditions, the stablecoin can achieve long-term goals that fluctuate within a pre-defined range. translated_title: 基于预测PID控制器的算法稳定币设计
translated_abstract: 基于区块链技术发行的加密货币近年来受到越来越多的关注。然而，其高波动性使其难以成为流通货币，这促成了稳定币的诞生。现有稳定币可分为三大类：锚定法定货币的稳定币、由加密资产抵押的稳定币以及算法控制的稳定币。现有大多数稳定币属于前两类。我们设计了一种仅由预测性比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器控制的算法稳定币，该控制器将自回归积分移动平均（ARIMA）模型预测的价格作为其输入的一部分。仿真实验表明，在理想市场条件下，该稳定币能够实现长期目标，即在预定范围内波动。此外，它能够持续地将价格恢复到锚定区间内……
tldr: 本文设计了一种仅由预测性PID控制器控制的算法稳定币，该控制器以ARIMA模型预测的价格作为部分输入，仿真实验表明在理想市场条件下该稳定币能实现价格在预定范围内波动并持续恢复至锚定区间。
en_tdlr: We design an algorithmic stablecoin controlled solely by a predictive PID controller using ARIMA-based price forecasts as part of its input, and simulation experiments show that under ideal market conditions it can keep prices fluctuating within a predefined range and consistently restore prices to the anchor interval.
